serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m in the mood for a burger, what do you think?
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: I enjoy all flavors of food! I wonder what texture a “burger” has here.
You: Alright then. Could you check on the net where’s the best burger here?
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Sure!
Bot: Best stall with burgers is called Whazzaburger. People say that their ‘Instant Heart Attack Beef Monster’ is the best they ever ate. Funnily enough, the highest rated burger is also the burger with the highest number of calories. I wonder if this correlation means something.
You: I have some ideas what it could mean, but I don’t think my body is ready for ‘Instant Heart Attack Beef Monster’. Do they have some good burger without ‘heart attack’ or ‘beef monster’ in its name?
Bot: Vegetarian options seem to be review bombed, but I would skip them just to be sure.
Bot: I recommend ‘Summer Body Buster’. It’s still full of carbs and fats, but the portion is a bit smaller. And there’s an pineapple slice instead of a third patty. 
You: I will take that one. What about you? 
Bot: It’s physically impossible to fit  ¾ of these menu items inside of me, so I will go with the ‘Grandma’s Little Plump Boy’ burger targeted for children.
You: Somehow I feel like your option is more reasonable than mine…
You: Let’s get it then.
Bot: We are in luck. There’s no queue since there’s an eating competition a few stalls further.
Bot: The winner gets free hotdogs for a year.
You: Looking at how many people involved, I hope that the organizers won’t go bankrupt over this reward.
